p0FrozenArchitecture.publishingSpecificLogicBoundary: Publishing is configured branch data, not the enterprise runtime owner.

p1ProductionHardeningReview.azureFunctionScaling: GAP - no live hosting-plan or scale configuration evidence was changed in this package.
p1ProductionHardeningReview.timerOverlapProtection: PARTIAL - social execution has row-level claim lease; control/creative/credential timers are idempotent but have no explicit distributed singleton lease.
p1ProductionHardeningReview.retryPolicy: PARTIAL - social execution supports RETRY_REQUIRED and stale-claim recovery; no global backoff/dead-letter service is present.
p1ProductionHardeningReview.deadLetterTerminalExceptions: PARTIAL - Dataverse exception/status fields exist; formal terminal dead-letter table/SLO is not implemented.
p1ProductionHardeningReview.idempotencyDuplicateProtection: PASS - platform ID guard, caption-prefix reconciliation, and offline regression cover post-publish Dataverse failure.
p1ProductionHardeningReview.platformReconciliation: PASS - Meta readback/reconciliation paths exist for Facebook and Instagram.
p1ProductionHardeningReview.appInsightsCorrelation: PARTIAL - JSON envelopes include correlation IDs; alert rules/workbook are not proven here.
p1ProductionHardeningReview.keyVaultSecretHygiene: PASS - runtime records secret references/metadata and sanitizes token-bearing JSON keys.
p1ProductionHardeningReview.configSeparation: PASS - branch destinations and runtime gates are config-driven.
p1ProductionHardeningReview.rollback: PARTIAL - repo has deploy workflow; runtime-specific rollback/runbook remains a canon candidate.
p1ProductionHardeningReview.branchIsolation: PASS - active Publishing branch is separated from One/Financial/Foundation inactive config.
p1ProductionHardeningReview.schemaMigrationVersioning: PARTIAL - setup scripts create Dataverse objects, but formal ordered migration versioning is still needed.
p1ProductionHardeningReview.publicMediaStorage: PASS - Azure Blob static web media writes verify SHA-256 readback before execution eligibility.
p1ProductionHardeningReview.journeySeedIntegrity: PASS - seed, generated JSON validation, second instantiation, and controlled live proof are recorded in package 810.

states.HEALTHY: All enabled branch adapters have successful recent runs, credentials valid beyond rotation window, no open terminal exceptions, readback matches expected platform state.
states.DEGRADED: One non-critical lane is delayed, retrying, or awaiting platform consistency while duplicate protection remains intact.
states.ATTENTION_REQUIRED: Credential rotation due, repeated retries, content/asset rights hold, LinkedIn external approval action, or compliance ambiguity.
states.FAILED: Credential expired, duplicate platform object detected, readback mismatch, unauthorized destination, public-ready failure bypass attempt, or journey/send failure.

p16SintraDecisionStandard.cancelWhen: Core operations are replaced, remaining unique strategy/ideation is not worth actual cost, and cancellation does not restore routine manual work.
p16SintraDecisionStandard.keepWhen: There is meaningful unique value independent of execution and it remains clearly non-authoritative.
p16SintraDecisionStandard.temporaryKeepWhen: Only if Sintra materially solves LinkedIn without browser work and without compromising exact creative control; no evidence currently proves this.

p17NoDualExecutionAuthority.rule: No platform/date/campaign item may have Sintra/Soshie and JM1-owned execution authority at the same time.
p17NoDualExecutionAuthority.finalSeptemberTruth: Facebook/Instagram final manual scheduler was Meta Business Suite UI; LinkedIn final manual scheduler was LinkedIn native organization UI; Sintra/Soshie execution objects were superseded and removed during remediation.
